title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Awareness and Current Affairs - Banking and Finance
subject: General Awareness and Current Affairs

questions.q: From 1 May 2025, which of the following portals did the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) mandate stakeholders to use?
questions.explain: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) mandated all stakeholders to use the 'PRAVAAH' (Platform for Regulatory Application, Validation and Authorisation) Portal starting from 1 May 2025.
